g.text: PROJECT POSTER | CARBONDROP | CARBON FOOTPRINT TRACKING & ANALYTICS
AI-powered carbon footprint tracking, forecasting, coaching, and action planning.
Turns everyday receipts, trips, and habits into clear emissions insights.
CarbonDrop is a full-stack sustainability platform that measures and explains personal carbon footprint data.
It combines document intelligence, analytics, forecasting, and recommendations in one workflow.
Dashboards, forecasts, coaching, and action plans
No receipt or activity is uploaded.
Receipt, trip, or usage data is captured.
The same pipeline drives receipts, trips, and daily habits into a single carbon budget view.
Action list, recipes, commutes, and habits
Insights, forecast, simulate, coach, and 30-day plan
Shared data access for carbon views and refresh flows
Coach, Forecast, Simulation, and Plan views
Households can track food, travel, and energy impact
Campuses can monitor awareness campaigns and reporting
Teams can compare activity and reduction goals
Sustainability programs can guide behavior change
Real-time analytics, modular UI, and protected access.
Built for measurable carbon planning and comparison.
Capture → Validate → Calculate → Suggest → Store → Dashboard.
Every step keeps the footprint explainable and actionable.
Carbon goals, plans, and daily actions
Lower household, campus, and team emissions
Make hidden carbon visible in everyday activity
Measure today. Reduce tomorrow. Sustain forever.
Mobile app for Android and iOS
IoT integrations for automatic data capture
Requirement analysis and system design - 1 week
Backend engine and API development - 4 weeks
